subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Humble
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Arrogant.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Humble
 not proud or not believing that you are important. (विनम्र)
 
 

 Arrogant
 unpleasantly proud and behaving as if you are more important than. (अभिमानी)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• ​​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Dishonour
 a feeling of embarrassment and loss of people's respect. (अपमान)
 
 

 Pleasantry
 a polite and often slightly humorous remark, usually made to help other people feel relaxed. (एक विनम्र और अक्सर थोड़ी विनोदी टिप्पणी, आमतौर पर अन्य लोगों को आराम महसूस करने में मदद करने के लिए की जाती है)
 
 

 Modest
 not usually talking about or making obvious your own abilities and achievements. (विनम्र)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Humble' and 'Arrogant' are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 4.
